text: A jigsaw has a small blade that goes up and down. It can cut curves.
Clamp the board with the part you are cutting hanging over the edge of the table.
Make sure nothing is under the cut, like the table or a cord.

tip.text: Keep both hands on the saw and wait for the blade to stop before you set it down.

text: Press the shoe flat on the board and push gently. Do not force it around tight curves.
